name: Chaklun Sniv
source:
Dreams have long been considered a bridge between the real world and the world of the subconscious. A dream sorcerer, you travel between dreams and memories hidden in the subconscious. This is exactly what you use, finding out the secrets of other people through their dreams and secret desires.

The city of Ketegis has many unusual people who can do unusual things. Werewolves, dark sorcerers, and other creatures. By selling secrets, you found yourself a part-time job in one of the bloodiest guilds in the city. Carrying out their assignments, you pay visits to the residents of the city, and who knows where this dream will turn this time?

[Translated from [url=https://rewiredd.itch.io/chaklun-sniv]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梦一直被认为是现实世界和潜意识世界之间的桥梁。作为一名梦境魔法师，你在梦境和隐藏在潜意识中的记忆之间穿梭。这正是你所使用的，通过别人的梦想和秘密欲望找出他们的秘密。

凯特吉斯市有许多不寻常的人，他们可以做不寻常的事情。狼人、黑暗巫师和其他生物。通过出售秘密，你在城里最血腥的行会之一找到了一份兼职工作。你执行任务，拜访城市居民，谁知道这一次的梦想会转向何处？
